queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS raw_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT year||month||day) AS partitions FROM orders_raw
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_kept, SUM(o.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM orders_raw o JOIN products_raw p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.year='2026' AND o.month='09' AND o.day='02'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orphan_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT o.product_id) AS orphan_products FROM orders_raw o LEFT JOIN products_raw p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.product_id IS NULL AND o.order_id <> 'order_id'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_order_ids, SUM(CASE WHEN order_id='order_id' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS header_rows_visible FROM orders_raw

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT year||'-'||month||'-'||day) AS raw_partitions, MIN(year||'-'||month||'-'||day) AS min_part, MAX(year||'-'||month||'-'||day) AS max_part, COUNT(DISTINCT date_format(date_parse(order_date,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),'%Y-%m-%d')) AS distinct_order_dates FROM orders_raw
SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS occurrences, MIN(order_date) AS earliest, MAX(order_date) AS latest FROM orders_raw GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 3
SELECT substr(latest,1,7) AS latest_month, COUNT(*) AS order_ids FROM (SELECT order_id, MAX(order_date) AS latest FROM orders_raw GROUP BY order_id) GROUP BY substr(latest,1,7) ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_kept, SUM(o.quantity * p.price) AS revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_price_rows FROM orders_raw o LEFT JOIN products_raw p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.year='2026' AND o.month='09' AND o.day='02'
